PRODUCT DESIGN CASE STUDY

Synqit

MY ROLE · Research, information architecture and end-to-end partnership UX/UI

Synqit

I designed Synqit to make business partnerships feel more structured than scattered cold messages. A request could be reviewed, accepted or declined, with both sides knowing where the relationship stood.

01What I wanted to solve

I interviewed founders, Web3 teams and investors, mapped the three roles and designed profiles, requests and messaging. Testing with businesses helped refine the trust signals in those flows.

02The decisions that mattered

Make the request the organising object.

I built the dashboard around pending, accepted and declined partnerships.

Let both sides choose the conversation.

I unlocked messaging after acceptance rather than making an unsolicited message the first step.

Give people something useful to review.

I used business details, expertise and partnership history to support the decision before a request is accepted.
